shared_elements: animate creatures carved on a flat surface
justification: The only real correspondence is the generic one that both surfaces carry shallow relief images of living creatures rendered in profile view; A's repertoire (rayed disc, human worshippers with raised arms, laden offering table, dense columns of script) has no counterpart in B's isolated quadruped above a sinuous reptilian form. A is a crowded, register-organised narrative composition with fine internal detailing, whereas B is a sparse, schematic outline of two unconnected animal figures on an otherwise blank field.
